description: A drum voice that synthesises a flatulence sound from a low tanh-shaped sine, brown and pink noise, and randomly fired bubble, formant and hiss events

params.text: Lowers the pitch of the tone, over 0 to 100; the core sine runs at 120Hz at the bottom of the travel and 50Hz at the top
Sets the attack, the decay and the peak of the envelope, over 0 to 1; at the top the attack is 80ms and the decay half a second, at the bottom 230ms and 1 second
Sets how far the slow pitch wobble and the random pitch drift reach, over 0 to 1; it also slows the fall of the pressure envelope and lengthens the formant ring
Lowers the whole output, over 0 to 1, by the square of what is left; at the top the module is silent
Sets the level of the noise layer and the loudness of the hiss bursts, over 0 to 1
Sets how wet the sound is, over 0 to 1: it moves the noise from brown toward pink, raises the resonant overtone, and makes the bubble and hiss events more frequent and louder
Restarts the envelope from the beginning when it is pressed, and holds the pressure envelope up for as long as it is held

inputs.text: Takes the Age knob over: -10V to 10V is spread across that knob's whole travel, and the knob cannot be set by hand while a cable is patched here
Takes the Urgency knob over: -10V to 10V is spread across that knob's whole travel, and the knob cannot be set by hand while a cable is patched here
Takes the Retention knob over: -10V to 10V is spread across that knob's whole travel, and the knob cannot be set by hand while a cable is patched here
Takes the Shame knob over: -10V to 10V is spread across that knob's whole travel, and the knob cannot be set by hand while a cable is patched here
Takes the Surprise knob over: -10V to 10V is spread across that knob's whole travel, and the knob cannot be set by hand while a cable is patched here
Takes the Food knob over: -10V to 10V is spread across that knob's whole travel, and the knob cannot be set by hand while a cable is patched here
Restarts the envelope on each rise above 1V, and holds the pressure envelope up for as long as the voltage stays there

outputs.text: The finished sound, soft-clipped through a tanh to about ±5.2V

notes: Every CV input writes into the knob it belongs to rather than adding to it, so the knob moves on screen while a cable is patched and keeps the position the cable left it in.
The module makes one sound as soon as it is placed in the rack: the envelope starts from the beginning with no trigger needed.
The six knobs are read once every 64 samples, so modulation faster than that arrives in steps.
An eighth input is declared and read alongside the trigger, with no jack drawn on the panel, so nothing can ever be patched into it.
